title: Luxuriant Egyptian Orange Skewers
description: A tangy and velvety Egyptian dish featuring marinated oranges, perfect for festive occasions. This satvik-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection on a tava-griddle.
instructions: Preheat the tava-griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, honey, rose water, and orange blossom water.
Add the orange segments to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated orange segments onto skewers.
Brush the tava-griddle with coconut oil and cook the orange skewers for 2-3 minutes per side.
Sprinkle chopped pine nuts over the orange skewers during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the Luxuriant Egyptian Orange Skewers warm, garnished with additional pine nuts if desired.
Let the skewers cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
